item.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
item.description:
Sales Development Representative (SDR)

Location: Dublin, Ireland (in office 4 days per week)

Experience: 2+ years professional experience is a plus

Department: Marketing

Reports to: Sr Manager, Sales Dev & Automation

Collaborating with our team of UKI Account Executives


About the Role

Red Sift works with over 2k customers worldwide, the UK is our home market where we work with brands like Jaguar Landrover, ITV, Wise and the UK gov. We’re looking for an SDR to fuel our continued growth in our largest market.

Our team is based in the Masonry Building in Dublin 8, we work together in person 4+ days a week to enable learning and a team environment. We started our SDR team with 3 reps two years ago, we are now growing the team to 5 in recognition of the quality of pipeline we have delivered for the sales org. Of our 3 first hires, 2 have been promoted to AE and CSM.


This is a startup environment where hard workers who take ownership thrive. Reps typically make 80 dials a day and reach out to 20 new clients per day, they are supported by an automated system in the back end with Claude doing account research, writing, persona selection, account mapping on their behalf.


Our team hit 100% of our team target in Q2 2026, and we just hit target again in July. We are looking for reps who will continue to increase the level of performance in our team.


What You’ll Do


  • Book meetings with target accounts using phone / email / LinkedIn (with the support of an AI backend system)


  • Occasional travel to industry events



What We’re Looking For


We don’t believe in checklists, but we do know the kind of person who thrives here:



💪 Mindset & Attributes


  • Grit – You show up, stay sharp, and keep moving forward


  • Drive – You don’t wait for doors to open, you knock


  • Smarts – You learn quickly and adapt faster


  • Coachability – You seek feedback and apply it with humility


  • Resilience – You don't flinch when others say, “No one’s answering the phone”



📈 Skills & Experience


  • Bonus points if you have 2+ years professional experience


Why Join Red Sift?

● 🌍 Be part of a global, mission-driven company in rapid scale-up mode


● 🔐 Help protect organizations and individuals from cyber threats at scale


● 💸 Competitive base salary + commission plan + equity


● 🏝 25 days of vacation + public holidays


● 📚 Self-development budget for coaching, courses, and events


● 🩺 Health Insurance + Gym Membership


● 👶 Maternity / Paternity leave


● 💥 One volunteer day per year to give back


Ready to show us what you're made of?

If you're motivated by purpose, thrive under pressure, and love the idea of building something meaningful from the front lines we’d love to hear from you.

item.title: IAM Product Engineer
item.description:
About us

We’re a cybersecurity SaaS company on a mission to help businesses stay ahead of emerging threats. Our platform provides innovative security solutions that balance usability with robust protection.

Red Sift is a global organization with offices in North America, Spain, Ireland and the UK. It boasts an impressive client base across all industries, including Domino’s, ZoomInfo, Athletic Greens, Pipedrive, and top global law firms.

We are leading the way in AI

Red Sift has been the first to deliver useful AI capabilities in the space and we want to continue leading the way in that front, preparing our products for the future and exposing our capabilities not only to humans but also to AI.

About the role

The mission of this role is to safeguard and enhance the reliability, security, and usability of Red Sift’s Identity and Access Management (IAM) and platform front-end systems. We ensure seamless, secure user experiences while maintaining robust access controls, empowering teams to innovate confidently on a trusted foundation.

You will contribute to diverse projects, operationalizing admin procedures to empower users and internal teams, and optimizing internal platform services like authentication and subscription management for peak performance and stability. Your responsibilities will be varied and impactful, offering a dynamic and challenging work environment.

A fundamental aspect of this position is the design and construction of robust, scalable, and high-performing code. You will be instrumental in building the platform that opens the door to all our current and future cybersecurity products.

We expect you to perform this role with high autonomy and sense of ownership while collaborating with and working through external teams and dependencies.

We expect you to operate with an AI-native mindset, leveraging shared standards, context-rich documentation, and automated agent loops to ensure our IAM platform is both secure and highly resilient. We value engineers who proactively build and maintain a workflow that makes AI development reliable and scalable.

If you are looking for an opportunity to take on a broad range of responsibilities, with significant autonomy, substantial room for professional growth and you embrace the new ways of working in the AI age, we encourage you to apply.

About you

You are a good human, open-minded and a team player. Our values resonate with you (Responsiveness, Empowerment, Diversity, Social Responsibility, Innovation, Fairness, Trust).

You are driven, and having a lot of autonomy motivates you.

You prioritise product and user experience.

You are a collaborative Software Engineer with proven professional experience in Javascript/Typescript, React, and Node.JS, you possess a strong understanding of API design, consumption, and client-side logic.

You are proficient in writing unit and integration tests and have experience with NoSQL databases like Mongo and version control systems such as Git. With excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, you demonstrate a solid understanding of software development principles, design patterns, and best practices.

You have experience in cloud platforms, deployment processes, and OAuth-like flows. Ideally with experience integrating LLM providers.

You are a practitioner of AI-native development. You don't just use AI, you orchestrate it. You are comfortable using structured prompt engineering, managing context/token usage, and applying specialized agents for testing, PR reviews, and code refinement. You have experience integrating AI into the full development lifecycle, from spec-driven planning and automated log analysis to CI/CD validation.

Our Stack

NodeJS, React, Typescript, Mongo, GitHub, Kubernetes, AWS, Vercel, Circle CI, Jest

Interviewing Process

We appreciate your time, your interest in the company and dedication during the interviewing process. We’ll do our best to move quickly through phases, provide feedback and keep it as short as possible for both sides to make a decision. Once we invite you for the first interview, we’ll do our best to complete it within the following 2 weeks.

  • Phase 1: Recruiting and HR introduction calls.

  • Phase 2: Technical interview including a live AI-coding exercise (90 min)

  • Phase 3: Behavioural interview with future manager (45 min)

  • Phase 4: Meet the CTO (30 min)

Location

Barcelona or London would be ideal but we would be happy to accommodate fully-remote working arrangements in locations with similar time zones.

Benefits

🌟 The opportunity to participate in every aspect of the startup journey in rapid scaling mode

✊🏽 The chance to participate in our mission to protect organisations and the people within them with cybersecurity software products that outsmart attackers at scale

💷 A competitive base salary based on experience in addition to a performance-based bonus, equity plan and pension scheme

🏝 25 days of vacation in addition to public holidays per year

🏥 Health Insurance

👪 Maternity / Paternity leave

🏋️ Gym membership

🚴 Cycle to work scheme

🦸 One volunteer day per year

🕰 Flexible working hours, we trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team

item.title: Business Automation Manager
item.description:
Role Purpose

We are looking for a coach-player leader to own and accelerate business automation across the company. This role will lead and work hands-on with a small team to proactively identify, design, and deliver automation that replaces manual processes, improves visibility, and drives measurable productivity gains.

As an AI-first company, this role sits at the intersection of operations, data, and AI. You will champion the use of AI, intelligent automation, and modern tooling to fundamentally improve how the business runs, not just make existing processes slightly faster.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Leadership

  • Own the business automation strategy end-to-end, aligned to company priorities

  • Identify high-impact opportunities to replace or redesign manual workflows across functions (e.g. Sales, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, HR)

  • Define success metrics for automation initiatives (time saved, cost reduction, visibility, quality, risk reduction)

Hands-On Delivery (Coach-Player)

  • Actively design and build automations alongside the team, this is not a purely managerial role

  • Rapidly prototype and deploy solutions using AI, workflow automation, and integration platforms

  • Balance speed with robustness: ship value quickly, then iterate

AI & Intelligent Automation

  • Apply AI pragmatically to real business problems (e.g. process automation, document handling, reporting, forecasting, decision support)

  • Continuously explore and evaluate new AI capabilities and tools, bringing practical use cases into production

  • Help the business understand where AI adds leverage and where it doesn’t

Business Partnership & Influence

  • Partner closely with functional leaders to uncover pain points and improvement opportunities
    Translate business problems into automation opportunities and technical solutions

  • Build trust through delivery and clear communication, not just ideas

Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a small automation team

  • Set standards for solution quality, documentation, and maintainability
    Create a culture of ownership, experimentation, and continuous improvement


What Success Looks Like

  • Manual, repetitive processes are systematically identified and eliminated

  • Leadership has better visibility into business performance through automated reporting and insights

  • Teams across the company feel enabled by automation rather than burdened by it

  • AI is used thoughtfully and productively, delivering tangible gains rather than hype

  • The automation function is seen as a strategic partner, not a support team

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience leading business automation, operations transformation, or intelligent automation initiatives

  • Strong hands-on experience with:

  • Workflow automation (e.g. Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato, custom solutions)

  • Data integration and APIs

  • AI-powered tools (LLMs, document processing, agents, analytics, etc.)

  • Ability to work comfortably across business and technical domains

  • Experience leading small teams while remaining deeply hands-on

Mindset & Approach

  • AI-native thinker, you instinctively ask “how should AI change this process?”

  • Pragmatic and outcome-focused: obsessed with value delivered, not tools used

  • Proactive: you don’t wait to be told what to automate

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and iteration

  • High ownership and accountability

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fast-growing or AI-driven companies

  • Background in operations, analytics, engineering, or product

  • Experience building internal platforms or automation centres of excellence

  • Salesforce integration experience


Why This Role at Red Sift

  • We are AI-first by design, not as a buzzword

  • You’ll have genuine ownership and influence across the business

  • Opportunity to define how automation and AI shape how the company operates

  • A culture that values experimentation, speed, and impact


Why Join Red Sift?

  • Be part of a global, mission-driven company in rapid scale-up mode

  • Help protect organizations and individuals from cyber threats at scale

  • Competitive base salary + commission plan  + equity

  • 25 days of vacation + public holidays

  • Self-development budget for coaching, courses, and events

  • Health Insurance + Gym Membership

  • Maternity / Paternity leave

  • One volunteer day per year to give back
